name: mellow
tagline: Take the day as it comes.
description: An easygoing identity for home goods and good moods. A soft four-point sparkle, warm peach fields, and wonderfully chunky type recall the optimism of a slower era.
heading: fraunces
rules: Sparkles use soft inward curves, never sharp straight spokes.
Keep backgrounds warm and use mulberry to anchor the composition.
Set short, chunky headlines with tight spacing and spacious supporting copy.

system.concept: Rounded sunburst ceramics, grooved color bands, hand-friendly shapes, and delightfully plump serif lettering. Nostalgia becomes an optimistic, useful everyday system.
headline: Good days.
At your own pace.
system.productNote: Make yourself a little more at home.
features: Everyday objects with a generous, easygoing personality.
Form and texture that make a place feel more like yours.
A collection that leaves room for your own rhythm.
system.layoutNote: Peach centered hero with chunky Fraunces lettering and a grooved sunburst. Mulberry controls, butter-colored rounded cards, and a relaxed sectional rhythm.
